definitions.gloss: Izumo Grand Shrine; major Shinto shrine in Shimane Prefecture
definitions.explanation: One of the most important and ancient Shinto shrines in Japan, located in Izumo, Shimane Prefecture. Dedicated to Ōkuninushi no Mikoto, the deity associated with marriage and relationships. A major pilgrimage destination.

notes:
One of Japan's oldest shrines, said to predate the written historical record. Dedicated to {大国主命|おおくにぬしのみこと} (Ōkuninushi no Mikoto), a deity associated with agriculture, medicine, and especially ⟦{縁結|えんむす}び→縁結び：14781_enmusubi⟧ (forming connections, including romantic ones).

NOTABLE FEATURES:
- The shrine uses 二礼四拍手一礼 (two bows, four claps, one bow) rather than the standard 二礼二拍手一礼
- In the lunar tenth month (⟦{神無月|かんなづき}→神無月：20362_kannazuki⟧), all the gods of Japan are said to gather at Izumo
- Features a massive ⟦{注連縄|しめなわ}→注連縄：06015_shimenawa⟧ (sacred rope)
